name: SWTAFE Women in Construction and Clean Energy Scholarship
summary: Up to $2,000 a year, to $8,000 total, for female apprentices in trade courses at South West TAFE.
key: Up to $2000 in support for each remaining year of your apprenticeship, up to $8000 over 4 years.
who: Female apprentices in first, second or third year of a trade course (automotive, building, cabinet making, civil construction, electrical, engineering, plumbing)
Preference for Warrnambool and surrounding districts
how: Apply via the SWTAFE scholarships page
